questions.q: What was Microsoft Entra ID called before Microsoft's 2023 rebrand?
questions.explain: Microsoft Entra ID is the renamed Azure Active Directory — same underlying cloud directory service, new name as of 2023.

questions.q: Which of these does traditional on-prem Active Directory require that Microsoft Entra ID does not?
options: Domain controllers running LDAP and Kerberos
questions.explain: On-prem AD depends on domain controllers you install and patch yourself, using LDAP and Kerberos. Entra ID has no domain controllers at all.

questions.q: How is Microsoft Entra ID actually managed and queried under the hood?
options: Only through a locally installed management console
Through REST API calls to the Microsoft Graph API over HTTPS
Through LDAP queries to a domain controller
questions.explain: Entra ID is API-first — the portal, PowerShell, and every admin tool all go through Microsoft Graph REST calls over HTTPS.

questions.q: What is a Microsoft Entra ID 'tenant'?
options: A synonym for a resource group
A single, dedicated Entra ID directory belonging to one organization
A virtual machine that hosts the directory service
A type of Azure subscription discount
questions.explain: A tenant is the dedicated directory instance for one organization, identified by a unique ID and typically a *.onmicrosoft.com domain.

questions.q: How many Entra ID tenants does a given Azure subscription trust?
options: Zero — subscriptions don't need a tenant
questions.explain: Each Azure subscription is linked to exactly one Entra ID tenant, which is what makes the tenant the real trust boundary in Azure.
